name: copy-toast
description: Numbers the copyable code blocks and commands in Claude's answer and stacks a Copy button for each above the prompt; press one to put it on the clipboard. A path that exists on disk also gets an open-folder button.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the on-screen text: en draws Copy, Copied and ▸ copy N; ko draws the Korean labels.

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: theme uses your Claude Code theme's color keys; palette uses the fixed gold-to-rose hex palette.
